description: Three synthetic community-group fixtures (Maple St, Riverside, Hillcrest), each with 3-4 groups, 60-90 members, 25-40 events, 6-10 sign-up sheets, RSVP and post history from January 2025, a companion Mail seed and an example scenario. The manifest seed is Hillcrest. For reproducible checks; not a benchmark task. All records are synthetic: no real group, person, post or message is used, nothing was crawled or collected, and there is no real-data anchor (the approved plan has no collection, and the reviewer confirmed that synthetic data is acceptable). Coverage of 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31 by month and source is in evidence/coverage.md (scripts/coverage-report.cjs).

sources.description: Maple St: a school parents group, a community garden, a block association and a run club. Eastern time (UTC-05:00). The user is Dana Okafor (m-001). People, groups, events (titles, venues and descriptions), sheets, key posts, background post texts, replies and Mail threads are written by hand; a fixed-seed generator draws past RSVPs, join dates, event lead times and post dates and authors at waking hours. Workflow structure (groups, roles, events, RSVPs, waitlists) follows Meetup's public help pages; the claim window, post audiences, child counts, sign-up sheets, member export and view-as are Stoopside's own rules.

provenance.real_anchor: none: no record is collected from a real website or service, and the reviewer confirmed that synthetic data needs no real anchor
provenance.generation: Deterministic Node scripts (this generator, scripts/fixture-builder.cjs and the specs in scripts/fixtures/). No language model is called when the fixtures are generated; the same scripts always produce byte-identical files (a business test fails if a committed file is out of date).
provenance.language_model_assistance: The scripts and their hand-written text (people, display names, bios, group descriptions, event titles, venues and descriptions, key posts, background post texts and replies in scripts/fixtures/text/, Mail threads and scenario events) were written with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude). Every background text and event description is used once. A fixed-seed generator draws past RSVPs, background members' join dates, event lead times and RSVP windows, background post dates and authors, with times at waking hours and minute resolution.
provenance.human_review: pending: Rohan Pandey has not yet read every member and event row (see review.status)

transformations: Each fixture uses one fixed UTC offset (no daylight-saving change); IDs are stable across resets.
Deliveries are recorded only for recent posts (Maple St from 2027-01-01, Riverside from 2026-03-01, Hillcrest from 2026-10-01); older notification history was not imported.

The manifest seed is fixtures/hillcrest.json (clock 2026-11-18 09:00 PST, the shared registry time); Maple St and Riverside load with env.load_seed, their own binding and their own clock (see README). scripts/generate-fixture.cjs --cutoff builds any fixture as a coherent prefix at an earlier clock.

review.notes: Not yet hand-reviewed. The fixture text was drafted with AI assistance (see each source's generation.parameters.provenance); the human read-through of every member and event row by Rohan Pandey, which the approved plan promises, is still pending, as is the clean-checkout reproduction by a second person. Automated checks (scripts/check-fixtures.cjs) do not replace that read.
